errors.evidence: The description states the categories are not ordered, but the first four categories are sorted in descending order based on their percentage values.

The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the correct term is length ("дължина"), not height ("височина"). This error is repeated with "Най-високият стълб" (highest bar) and "най-ниският стълб" (lowest bar).
The bar for "финансова подкрепа" ends approximately halfway between 50% and 60%, making the value closer to 55%, not 53%.
The bar for "няма нужда от подкрепа" ends halfway between 10% and 20%, indicating a value of approximately 15%, not 12%.
The bar for "обучение по предприемачество" ends approximately halfway between 30% and 40%, indicating a value of around 35% (the reference states 34%), not 32%.
